# Privacy Policy

**Last updated: 13 September 2026**

This Privacy Policy explains how IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD., operating the TiO2 Malaysia website, collects, uses, shares and retains personal data when you browse the site or contact us.

For privacy questions or requests, email **info@tio2malaysia.com**. You can also read this policy in [Bahasa Malaysia](/ms/privacy-policy/) or review our [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy/).

Actions: **CONTACT US ABOUT PRIVACY** · **MANAGE COOKIE SETTINGS**

## Who We Are

TiO2 Malaysia is a business-to-business website operated by **IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD.** We are responsible for deciding how personal data submitted through this website is used for our business purposes.

Privacy contact: **info@tio2malaysia.com**

Postal correspondence may be sent to:

**IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD.**  
No. 33, Industrial Perusahaan Ringan Tupai  
34000 Taiping, Perak, Malaysia

This is presented as a business and correspondence address, not as a statement that it is the company’s registered office or a public visitor address.

## Information We Collect

### Information you provide

When you request a quotation, we may collect:

- the product grade and application you are asking about;
- requested quantity and destination country;
- destination port or city, if supplied;
- company name, contact name and business email address;
- phone or WhatsApp number and company website, if supplied;
- additional requirements or other information you choose to include; and
- the page or context from which the inquiry was started.

When you submit a Request Documents form, we collect:

- Full Name;
- Company;
- Business Email;
- Country/Region;
- Product Grade;
- the selected Document Types;
- Application/Industry, if supplied; and
- Additional Requirements, if supplied.

Where applicable, we may also process the page or source context, a stable request token, site and workflow identifiers, and the minimum technical routing and security data needed to direct, protect and troubleshoot the submission.

We also collect information contained in later emails or other business correspondence relating to your inquiry or document request.

Please do not include sensitive personal data, confidential credentials, payment-card information or unrelated personal information in a free-text field. The current quotation and Request Documents forms do not request file uploads or special-category personal data.

If we later introduce a sample-request form with an active production receiver, this policy will be updated to describe its verified fields and purposes before that workflow is released.

### Technical and usage information

When you use the website, hosting, delivery and security systems may process technical information needed to serve and protect the site, such as an IP address, date and time, requested URL, browser or device information, referrer and security or routing data.

We use Google Analytics, delivered through Google Tag Manager, to measure aggregate website use and site performance. Analytics storage is off by default and is enabled only after you choose **Accept analytics**. When Analytics storage is denied, consent-aware Google tags may still send limited cookieless measurement signals to Google. See our Cookie Policy for the current storage and consent details.

## How We Use Information

We use personal data to:

- receive, review and respond to product, quotation, document-request and other business inquiries;
- understand the product, application, quantity and destination relevant to a quotation or product inquiry;
- review the Product Grade, requested Document Types, optional Application/Industry and business context relevant to a document request;
- confirm the intended request scope, assess whether relevant documents may be available or provided, and conduct any necessary follow-up communication;
- communicate about an inquiry or document request and maintain related B2B correspondence;
- operate, deliver, secure and troubleshoot the website and form service;
- prevent spam, abuse, fraud and malicious activity;
- comply with applicable legal obligations and establish, exercise or defend legal claims; and
- measure aggregate website use when optional Analytics is active and the relevant choice permits it.

Submitting a document request does not confirm that a requested document exists, applies to a particular product or situation, or will be provided or sent.

Depending on the circumstances and the law that applies, processing may be necessary to respond to steps you request before a business arrangement, to pursue our legitimate interests in operating and securing a B2B website and responding to inquiries, to comply with legal obligations, or to act on your consent for an optional feature such as Analytics.

Submitting an inquiry is not consent to receive unrelated promotional marketing. We do not use the inquiry form to make decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal or similarly significant effects about you.

## Service Providers and International Processing

We use service providers to operate the website and deliver inquiries. They process information for the relevant service purpose and may operate infrastructure in more than one country.

### Web3Forms

Quotation and document-request submissions are transmitted through **Web3Forms**, operated by Web3Creative. Web3Forms acts as a processor for form-submission data and sends each submission to the email recipient configured by IKHLAS for the relevant workflow.

For the current Request Documents workflow, the browser submits directly to the fixed Web3Forms endpoint under the Free plan. An access key routes the submission to the recipient configured by IKHLAS. The access key is a browser-available routing identifier for this workflow, not a mailbox password or private secret. We do not publish the access-key value or recipient email address in this Policy.

For service delivery, infrastructure, security and spam prevention, Web3Forms may use providers identified in its current service documentation, including AWS, Cloudflare, Hetzner, CleanTalk and Akismet, depending on how a submission is handled. Technical submission information may include an IP address, timestamp and referrer.

Because Web3Forms and its providers may process data outside Malaysia or the country where you are located, form submissions may involve international processing. We assess and manage these arrangements under applicable requirements and the provider’s contractual terms.

### Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager

We use Google Analytics to measure aggregate website use and site performance, and Google Tag Manager to manage the measurement tag. Google may receive page and event information, consent signals and limited technical information. When Analytics storage is denied, consent-aware Google tags may send limited cookieless measurement signals. When you choose **Accept analytics**, Google Analytics may use the Analytics Cookies listed in our Cookie Policy.

We do not send names, email addresses, telephone numbers, company names, free-text inquiry content or form submissions to Google Analytics. Advertising storage, advertising user data and advertising personalisation remain denied. We do not use this setup for remarketing, audience building or personalised advertising.

Google may process measurement data outside Malaysia or the country where you are located. More information about the active storage items, consent conditions and how to withdraw your choice is available in our Cookie Policy and Cookie Settings.

### Other operational providers and recipients

Website hosting, security and email-delivery providers may process the limited information needed to provide their services. Within IKHLAS, access is limited to authorised personnel who need the information to handle the inquiry or perform relevant operational, legal or security work.

We may also disclose information where required by law, a lawful authority or legal process, or where reasonably necessary to protect rights, safety and the integrity of our services. We do not sell personal data submitted through the inquiry form.

## How Long We Keep Information

IKHLAS normally keeps inquiry information and related correspondence for up to **three years from the last substantive interaction or closure of the inquiry**.

We may keep a limited record for longer where reasonably necessary to comply with a legal obligation, address fraud or security issues, resolve a dispute, or establish, exercise or defend a legal claim. When information is no longer required for an applicable purpose, it is deleted or otherwise disposed of in accordance with our retention controls.

Web3Forms’ Free plan currently shows form-submission history in its dashboard for 30 days. That visibility period is not the same as physical deletion. Web3Forms states that submission data may have a physical retention period of up to three years under its current retention terms.

Technical logs and consent-preference records follow the retention periods of the verified systems used at release. The Cookie Policy identifies the current browser-storage duration where applicable.

## Cookies and Analytics

The website uses Cookies, Local Storage and similar technologies to remember privacy choices and measure aggregate website use.

We use Google Analytics through Google Tag Manager. Before you make a choice, `analytics_storage`, `ad_storage`, `ad_user_data` and `ad_personalization` are set to `denied`. If you choose **Accept analytics**, only `analytics_storage` changes to `granted`. The three advertising-related states remain `denied`.

If you choose **Necessary only** or withdraw Analytics, Analytics storage remains or returns to denied. Consent-aware Google tags may still send limited cookieless measurement signals while storage is denied, but Analytics Cookies are not used in that state.

Use **Cookie Settings** in the Footer to review or change your choice. See the [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy/) for the current Cookie and Local Storage inventory.

## Your Rights and Choices

Your rights depend on where you are located and which law applies. Subject to applicable conditions and exceptions, you may ask us to:

- confirm whether we process personal data about you and provide access to it;
- correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data;
- withdraw consent for processing that relies on consent;
- object to or ask us to stop certain processing, including direct marketing;
- delete personal data or restrict how it is used;
- provide eligible personal data in a portable format; or
- explain how we have handled a privacy request.

You can change an available Analytics choice at any time through **Cookie Settings**. Withdrawing consent does not affect processing that was lawful before withdrawal.

To make a request, email **info@tio2malaysia.com** and describe what you would like us to do. We may ask for information reasonably necessary to verify your identity and locate the relevant record. A request may be limited or refused where applicable law permits or requires it, including where information must be retained for a legal obligation or claim or where fulfilling the request would adversely affect the rights of another person. We will explain our response where required.

Where applicable, you may also complain to the personal-data or privacy supervisory authority in your country, including Malaysia’s Personal Data Protection authority or the relevant authority in the European Union or United Kingdom.

## Security and Data Minimisation

We use reasonable administrative, technical and organisational measures intended to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, alteration, misuse or disclosure. Access is limited according to business need, and we seek to collect only information relevant to the inquiry or service purpose.

No online transmission or storage method can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Please use the designated business inquiry fields and avoid sending unnecessary sensitive or confidential personal information.

## Business Users and Children

This website and its inquiry services are intended for business users and are not directed to children. We do not knowingly seek personal data from anyone under 18 through the B2B inquiry workflow.

If you believe a child has submitted personal data through the website, contact **info@tio2malaysia.com** so that we can review the circumstances and take appropriate action.

If you provide information about another person, you should have appropriate authority to do so and should direct that person to this Privacy Policy where relevant.

## Changes and Contact

We may update this Privacy Policy when our forms, service providers, technology or legal obligations change. The date at the top identifies the latest version. Material changes will be presented through an appropriate website notice where required.

For privacy questions, rights requests or concerns, contact:

**IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD.**  
Email: **info@tio2malaysia.com**

Actions: **CONTACT US ABOUT PRIVACY** · **MANAGE COOKIE SETTINGS**

# Dasar Privasi

**Kemas kini terakhir: 13 September 2026**

Dasar Privasi ini menerangkan cara IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD., sebagai pengendali laman web TiO2 Malaysia, mengumpul, menggunakan, berkongsi dan menyimpan data peribadi apabila anda melayari laman ini atau menghubungi kami.

Untuk pertanyaan atau permintaan berkaitan privasi, e-mel **info@tio2malaysia.com**. Anda juga boleh membaca [Privacy Policy dalam bahasa Inggeris](/privacy-policy/) atau merujuk [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy/).

Tindakan: **HUBUNGI KAMI MENGENAI PRIVASI** · **URUS TETAPAN KUKI**

## Siapa Kami

TiO2 Malaysia ialah laman web perniagaan-ke-perniagaan yang dikendalikan oleh **IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD.** Kami bertanggungjawab menentukan cara data peribadi yang dihantar melalui laman web ini digunakan bagi tujuan perniagaan kami.

Hubungan privasi: **info@tio2malaysia.com**

Surat-menyurat boleh dihantar kepada:

**IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD.**  
No. 33, Industrial Perusahaan Ringan Tupai  
34000 Taiping, Perak, Malaysia

Alamat ini dinyatakan sebagai alamat perniagaan dan surat-menyurat. Ia bukan pernyataan bahawa alamat tersebut ialah pejabat berdaftar syarikat atau alamat untuk lawatan orang awam.

## Maklumat yang Kami Kumpulkan

### Maklumat yang anda berikan

Apabila anda meminta sebut harga, kami mungkin mengumpul:

- gred produk dan aplikasi yang ditanya;
- kuantiti yang diminta dan negara destinasi;
- pelabuhan atau bandar destinasi, jika diberikan;
- nama syarikat, nama orang untuk dihubungi dan alamat e-mel perniagaan;
- nombor telefon atau WhatsApp dan laman web syarikat, jika diberikan;
- keperluan tambahan atau maklumat lain yang anda pilih untuk sertakan; dan
- halaman atau konteks tempat pertanyaan tersebut dimulakan.

Apabila anda menghantar borang Request Documents, kami mengumpul:

- Nama Penuh;
- Syarikat;
- E-mel Perniagaan;
- Negara/Rantau;
- Gred Produk;
- Jenis Dokumen yang dipilih;
- Aplikasi/Industri, jika diberikan; dan
- Keperluan Tambahan, jika diberikan.

Apabila berkenaan, kami juga mungkin memproses konteks halaman atau sumber, token permintaan yang stabil, pengecam laman dan aliran kerja, serta data teknikal minimum bagi penghalaan dan keselamatan yang diperlukan untuk mengarahkan, melindungi dan menyelesaikan masalah penghantaran.

Kami juga mengumpul maklumat dalam e-mel susulan atau surat-menyurat perniagaan lain yang berkaitan dengan pertanyaan atau permintaan dokumen anda.

Jangan masukkan data peribadi sensitif, kelayakan akses sulit, maklumat kad pembayaran atau maklumat peribadi yang tidak berkaitan dalam ruangan teks bebas. Borang sebut harga dan Request Documents semasa tidak meminta muat naik fail atau data peribadi kategori khas.

Jika kami memperkenalkan borang permintaan sampel dengan penerima produksi yang aktif pada masa hadapan, dasar ini akan dikemas kini untuk menerangkan medan dan tujuan yang telah disahkan sebelum aliran kerja tersebut diterbitkan.

### Maklumat teknikal dan penggunaan

Apabila anda menggunakan laman web ini, sistem pengehosan, penyampaian dan keselamatan mungkin memproses maklumat teknikal yang diperlukan untuk menyampaikan dan melindungi laman, seperti alamat IP, tarikh dan masa, URL yang diminta, maklumat pelayar atau peranti, perujuk serta data keselamatan atau penghalaan.

Kami menggunakan Google Analytics, yang disampaikan melalui Google Tag Manager, untuk mengukur penggunaan laman web secara agregat dan prestasi laman. Penyimpanan Analitik dimatikan secara lalai dan hanya diaktifkan selepas anda memilih **Accept analytics**. Apabila penyimpanan Analitik ditolak, tag Google yang mengetahui status persetujuan masih boleh menghantar isyarat pengukuran tanpa kuki yang terhad kepada Google. Rujuk Cookie Policy kami untuk butiran penyimpanan dan persetujuan semasa.

## Cara Kami Menggunakan Maklumat

Kami menggunakan data peribadi untuk:

- menerima, menyemak dan menjawab pertanyaan produk, sebut harga, permintaan dokumen dan pertanyaan perniagaan lain;
- memahami produk, aplikasi, kuantiti dan destinasi yang berkaitan dengan sebut harga atau pertanyaan produk;
- menyemak Gred Produk, Jenis Dokumen yang diminta, Aplikasi/Industri pilihan dan konteks perniagaan yang berkaitan dengan permintaan dokumen;
- mengesahkan skop permintaan yang dimaksudkan, menilai sama ada dokumen berkaitan mungkin tersedia atau boleh diberikan, dan menjalankan komunikasi susulan yang diperlukan;
- berkomunikasi mengenai pertanyaan atau permintaan dokumen dan menyimpan surat-menyurat B2B yang berkaitan;
- mengendalikan, menyampaikan, melindungi dan menyelesaikan masalah laman web serta perkhidmatan borang;
- mencegah spam, penyalahgunaan, penipuan dan aktiviti berniat jahat;
- mematuhi kewajipan undang-undang yang berkenaan serta mewujudkan, melaksanakan atau mempertahankan tuntutan undang-undang; dan
- mengukur penggunaan laman web secara agregat apabila Analitik pilihan aktif dan pilihan yang berkaitan membenarkannya.

Penghantaran permintaan dokumen tidak mengesahkan bahawa dokumen yang diminta wujud, terpakai kepada produk atau keadaan tertentu, atau akan diberikan atau dihantar.

Bergantung pada keadaan dan undang-undang yang terpakai, pemprosesan mungkin diperlukan untuk menjawab langkah yang anda minta sebelum suatu urusan perniagaan, untuk kepentingan sah kami dalam mengendalikan dan melindungi laman B2B serta menjawab pertanyaan, untuk mematuhi kewajipan undang-undang, atau berdasarkan persetujuan anda bagi ciri pilihan seperti Analitik.

Penghantaran pertanyaan bukan persetujuan untuk menerima pemasaran promosi yang tidak berkaitan. Kami tidak menggunakan borang pertanyaan untuk membuat keputusan berasaskan pemprosesan automatik sepenuhnya yang menghasilkan kesan undang-undang atau kesan penting yang serupa terhadap anda.

## Penyedia Perkhidmatan dan Pemprosesan Antarabangsa

Kami menggunakan penyedia perkhidmatan untuk mengendalikan laman web dan menyampaikan pertanyaan. Mereka memproses maklumat bagi tujuan perkhidmatan yang berkaitan dan mungkin mengendalikan infrastruktur di lebih daripada satu negara.

### Web3Forms

Penghantaran sebut harga dan permintaan dokumen dihantar melalui **Web3Forms**, yang dikendalikan oleh Web3Creative. Web3Forms bertindak sebagai pemproses bagi data penghantaran borang dan menghantar setiap penghantaran kepada penerima e-mel yang dikonfigurasikan oleh IKHLAS bagi aliran kerja yang berkaitan.

Bagi aliran kerja Request Documents semasa, pelayar menghantar terus ke titik akhir Web3Forms tetap di bawah Pelan Percuma. Kunci Akses mengarahkan penghantaran kepada penerima yang dikonfigurasikan oleh IKHLAS. Kunci Akses ialah pengecam penghalaan yang tersedia kepada pelayar bagi aliran kerja ini, bukannya kata laluan peti mel atau rahsia peribadi. Kami tidak menerbitkan nilai Kunci Akses atau alamat e-mel penerima dalam Dasar ini.

Bagi penyampaian perkhidmatan, infrastruktur, keselamatan dan pencegahan spam, Web3Forms mungkin menggunakan penyedia yang dikenal pasti dalam dokumentasi perkhidmatan semasanya, termasuk AWS, Cloudflare, Hetzner, CleanTalk dan Akismet, bergantung pada cara sesuatu penghantaran diproses. Maklumat teknikal penghantaran mungkin termasuk alamat IP, cap masa dan perujuk.

Oleh sebab Web3Forms dan penyedianya mungkin memproses data di luar Malaysia atau negara tempat anda berada, penghantaran borang mungkin melibatkan pemprosesan antarabangsa. Kami menilai dan mengurus pengaturan ini mengikut keperluan yang terpakai dan terma kontrak penyedia.

### Google Analytics dan Google Tag Manager

Kami menggunakan Google Analytics untuk mengukur penggunaan laman web secara agregat dan prestasi laman, serta Google Tag Manager untuk mengurus tag pengukuran. Google mungkin menerima maklumat halaman dan peristiwa, isyarat persetujuan dan maklumat teknikal yang terhad. Apabila penyimpanan Analitik ditolak, tag Google yang mengetahui status persetujuan mungkin menghantar isyarat pengukuran tanpa kuki yang terhad. Apabila anda memilih **Accept analytics**, Google Analytics mungkin menggunakan Kuki Analitik yang disenaraikan dalam Cookie Policy kami.

Kami tidak menghantar nama, alamat e-mel, nombor telefon, nama syarikat, kandungan pertanyaan dalam teks bebas atau penghantaran borang kepada Google Analytics. Penyimpanan pengiklanan, data pengguna pengiklanan dan pemperibadian pengiklanan kekal ditolak. Kami tidak menggunakan tetapan ini untuk pemasaran semula, pembinaan khalayak atau pengiklanan diperibadikan.

Google mungkin memproses data pengukuran di luar Malaysia atau negara tempat anda berada. Maklumat lanjut tentang item penyimpanan yang aktif, syarat persetujuan dan cara menarik balik pilihan anda tersedia dalam Cookie Policy dan Cookie Settings kami.

### Penyedia operasi dan penerima lain

Penyedia pengehosan laman web, keselamatan dan penyampaian e-mel mungkin memproses maklumat terhad yang diperlukan untuk menyediakan perkhidmatan mereka. Dalam IKHLAS, akses dihadkan kepada kakitangan yang diberi kuasa dan memerlukan maklumat tersebut untuk mengendalikan pertanyaan atau menjalankan kerja operasi, undang-undang atau keselamatan yang berkaitan.

Kami juga mungkin mendedahkan maklumat apabila dikehendaki oleh undang-undang, pihak berkuasa yang sah atau proses undang-undang, atau apabila semunasabahnya perlu untuk melindungi hak, keselamatan dan integriti perkhidmatan kami. Kami tidak menjual data peribadi yang dihantar melalui borang pertanyaan.

## Tempoh Kami Menyimpan Maklumat

IKHLAS biasanya menyimpan maklumat pertanyaan dan surat-menyurat berkaitan sehingga **tiga tahun dari interaksi substantif terakhir atau penutupan pertanyaan**.

Kami mungkin menyimpan rekod terhad lebih lama apabila semunasabahnya perlu untuk mematuhi kewajipan undang-undang, menangani penipuan atau isu keselamatan, menyelesaikan pertikaian, atau mewujudkan, melaksanakan atau mempertahankan tuntutan undang-undang. Apabila maklumat tidak lagi diperlukan bagi tujuan yang terpakai, maklumat tersebut dipadam atau dilupuskan mengikut kawalan penyimpanan kami.

Pelan Percuma Web3Forms pada masa ini memaparkan sejarah penghantaran borang dalam papan pemukanya selama 30 hari. Tempoh paparan itu bukan tempoh pemadaman fizikal. Di bawah terma penyimpanan semasanya, Web3Forms menyatakan bahawa data penghantaran mungkin disimpan secara fizikal sehingga tiga tahun.

Log teknikal dan rekod pilihan persetujuan mengikut tempoh penyimpanan sistem yang telah disahkan dan digunakan semasa penerbitan. Cookie Policy mengenal pasti tempoh penyimpanan pelayar semasa apabila berkenaan.

## Kuki dan Analitik

Laman web ini menggunakan Kuki, Local Storage dan teknologi yang serupa untuk mengingati pilihan privasi dan mengukur penggunaan laman web secara agregat.

Kami menggunakan Google Analytics melalui Google Tag Manager. Sebelum anda membuat pilihan, `analytics_storage`, `ad_storage`, `ad_user_data` dan `ad_personalization` ditetapkan kepada `denied`. Jika anda memilih **Accept analytics**, hanya `analytics_storage` berubah kepada `granted`. Tiga keadaan berkaitan pengiklanan kekal `denied`.

Jika anda memilih **Necessary only** atau menarik balik Analitik, penyimpanan Analitik kekal atau kembali ditolak. Tag Google yang mengetahui status persetujuan masih boleh menghantar isyarat pengukuran tanpa kuki yang terhad ketika penyimpanan ditolak, tetapi Kuki Analitik tidak digunakan dalam keadaan itu.

Gunakan **Cookie Settings** di bahagian Footer untuk menyemak atau menukar pilihan anda. Rujuk [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy/) untuk inventori Kuki dan Local Storage semasa.

## Hak dan Pilihan Anda

Hak anda bergantung pada lokasi anda dan undang-undang yang terpakai. Tertakluk pada syarat dan pengecualian yang berkenaan, anda boleh meminta kami untuk:

- mengesahkan sama ada kami memproses data peribadi tentang anda dan memberikan akses kepadanya;
- membetulkan data peribadi yang tidak tepat atau tidak lengkap;
- menarik balik persetujuan bagi pemprosesan yang bergantung pada persetujuan;
- membantah atau meminta kami menghentikan pemprosesan tertentu, termasuk pemasaran langsung;
- memadam data peribadi atau mengehadkan cara ia digunakan;
- memberikan data peribadi yang layak dalam format mudah alih; atau
- menerangkan cara kami mengendalikan permintaan privasi.

Anda boleh menukar pilihan Analitik yang tersedia pada bila-bila masa melalui **Cookie Settings**. Penarikan balik persetujuan tidak menjejaskan pemprosesan yang sah sebelum persetujuan ditarik balik.

Untuk membuat permintaan, e-mel **info@tio2malaysia.com** dan terangkan tindakan yang anda mahu kami ambil. Kami mungkin meminta maklumat yang semunasabahnya diperlukan untuk mengesahkan identiti anda dan mencari rekod yang berkaitan. Sesuatu permintaan mungkin dihadkan atau ditolak apabila undang-undang yang terpakai membenarkan atau menghendakinya, termasuk apabila maklumat perlu disimpan bagi kewajipan atau tuntutan undang-undang atau apabila pemenuhan permintaan akan menjejaskan hak orang lain. Kami akan menerangkan jawapan kami apabila dikehendaki.

Apabila berkenaan, anda juga boleh membuat aduan kepada pihak berkuasa penyeliaan data peribadi atau privasi di negara anda, termasuk pihak berkuasa Perlindungan Data Peribadi Malaysia atau pihak berkuasa berkaitan di Kesatuan Eropah atau United Kingdom.

## Keselamatan dan Peminimuman Data

Kami menggunakan langkah pentadbiran, teknikal dan organisasi yang munasabah untuk melindungi data peribadi daripada akses tanpa kebenaran, kehilangan, pengubahan, penyalahgunaan atau pendedahan. Akses dihadkan mengikut keperluan perniagaan, dan kami berusaha mengumpul hanya maklumat yang berkaitan dengan tujuan pertanyaan atau perkhidmatan.

Tiada kaedah penghantaran atau penyimpanan dalam talian yang boleh dijamin selamat sepenuhnya. Sila gunakan medan pertanyaan perniagaan yang disediakan dan elakkan menghantar maklumat peribadi sensitif atau sulit yang tidak diperlukan.

## Pengguna Perniagaan dan Kanak-kanak

Laman web ini dan perkhidmatan pertanyaannya ditujukan kepada pengguna perniagaan dan bukan kepada kanak-kanak. Kami tidak dengan sengaja meminta data peribadi daripada sesiapa yang berumur di bawah 18 tahun melalui aliran kerja pertanyaan B2B.

## Perubahan dan Cara Menghubungi Kami

# Cookie Policy

**Last updated: 13 September 2026**

This Cookie Policy explains how TiO2 Malaysia uses Cookies and similar technologies, which technologies are active, and how you can manage available preferences.

For information about our broader handling of personal data, read our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy/).

Actions: **MANAGE COOKIE SETTINGS** · **READ OUR PRIVACY POLICY**

## Cookies and Similar Technologies

Cookies are small text records that a website may ask a browser to store. Websites can also use other browser technologies, including Local Storage, to retain limited information between pages or visits.

TiO2 Malaysia uses the term “Cookies and similar technologies” to cover these mechanisms collectively. An item in Local Storage is not technically a Cookie, and our inventory identifies the relevant type.

## Categories We Use

### Necessary

Necessary technologies support functions such as site delivery, security and remembering a privacy choice. They are not used to grant optional Analytics, advertising storage or advertising personalisation.

### Analytics

Google Analytics is active for aggregate website measurement and is managed through Google Tag Manager. Analytics storage is off by default. It is enabled only after you choose **Accept analytics**. Advertising storage, advertising user data and advertising personalisation remain denied in every state.

### Advertising and personalisation

No advertising or advertising-personalisation category is active in the currently verified configuration. Google Ads is not enabled. Advertising storage, advertising user data and advertising personalisation remain denied under the approved consent direction.

## Current Cookie and Storage Inventory

| Name | Provider | Type | Purpose | Duration | Category | Consent condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tio2_my_consent_v1` | TiO2 Malaysia | Local Storage | Remembers the Analytics choice, consent version and decision time for this site | Until browser storage is cleared or the consent version is replaced | Necessary | Used to remember the visitor's choice |
| `_ga` | Google Analytics | Cookie | Distinguishes browsers for aggregate website measurement | Up to 2 years | Analytics | Set only when `analytics_storage=granted` |
| `_ga_QDHLMRH2WB` | Google Analytics | Cookie | Maintains measurement state for the TiO2 Malaysia GA4 property | Up to 2 years | Analytics | Set only when `analytics_storage=granted` |

## How Advanced Consent Mode Works

TiO2 Malaysia uses Google Advanced Consent Mode. Before you make a choice, `analytics_storage`, `ad_storage`, `ad_user_data` and `ad_personalization` are set to `denied`.

When storage is denied, consent-aware Google tags may send limited cookieless measurement signals to Google. Analytics Cookies are not used while `analytics_storage` remains denied. If you choose **Accept analytics**, only `analytics_storage` changes to `granted`; the three advertising-related states remain `denied`.

You can choose **Necessary only**, accept Analytics or withdraw Analytics at any time through **Cookie Settings** in the Footer.

## Manage or Withdraw Your Choice

Use **Cookie Settings** in the Footer to review or change your choice. Optional Analytics is off by default. You can choose **Accept analytics** or **Necessary only**, and you can withdraw an Analytics choice through the same Footer control.

Choosing **Necessary only** or withdrawing Analytics immediately returns `analytics_storage` to `denied` and removes the known Analytics Cookies for this property where the browser permits. The three advertising-related states remain `denied`. Closing Cookie Settings without saving preserves your existing choice. Withdrawing a choice does not undo processing that was lawful before withdrawal.

## Browser Controls

Most browsers allow you to view, delete or block Cookies and site data. Blocking all browser storage may prevent a preference from being remembered and may affect functions that genuinely require storage. Clearing site data may cause the preference interface to appear again.

Browser settings operate separately from the controls provided by TiO2 Malaysia. Refer to your browser’s help information for instructions specific to your browser and device.

## Changes and Contact

We update this Cookie Policy when the active technology, purpose, provider or duration changes. The date at the top identifies the latest version.

For questions about Cookies, browser storage or privacy choices, email **info@tio2malaysia.com**.

Actions: **MANAGE COOKIE SETTINGS** · **READ OUR PRIVACY POLICY**
